title: Positive biased total influence
statement: Let $p\\in(0,1)$ and let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. If $f$ is nonconstant, then its total influence under the product distribution with bias parameter $p$ is strictly positive.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
